When I eventually got through, I was told there were no appointments available on Friday, which is my day off. The only option offered was a telephone appointment on Tuesday with a one-hour window between 10 and 11 a.m., which is difficult for anyone who works during the week.

After waiting nearly an hour on the phone, it was very frustrating to find that there was so little flexibility. I eventually hung up out of frustration. The system for arranging appointments clearly needs improvement.

What happened is unfortunately poor patient access management. I effectively encountered two structural problems:

Inbound call bottleneck – 55-minute wait suggests the practice phone system or staffing is under capacity.

Wide telephone windows – “10–11 am” blocks may be used to allow GPs to run late, but they create problems for patients working normal hours.

Under NHS rules, GP practices must provide reasonable access to appointments. If you encounter similar situations you can:

Make a complaint to the practice manager.

Escalate to your regional NHS England patient complaints service."

I removed the review following a positive reply "...I've checked our appointment system and we do have available appointments now on Friday 10th April, so please do let me know if you would like me to book this for you - complaints.kingfisher@nhs.net." Julie
